# Photivra (@photivra/engine)

> Photivra is an Apache-2.0 TypeScript library for the science of photography: camera geometry, optics, focus and depth of field, exposure, motion, diffraction, sensor signal and noise, colour, RAW and image formation. It runs in browsers and Node 22.13 or later, makes no network calls and needs no API key. Most functions take one input object with units in the field names (`focalLengthMm`, `focusDistanceM`, `shutterSeconds`) and return `{ value, provenance }`. `provenance.kind` says whether a result is `calculated` or an `approximation`. The built-in camera tiers are synthetic educational designs, not real cameras.

## Start here

- [Agent guide](https://github.com/Photivra/engine/blob/main/docs/AGENT_GUIDE.md): which function to call, units, reading results, errors and limits
- [Quick start](https://github.com/Photivra/engine/blob/main/docs/QUICK_START.md): `simulateCapture()` inputs, defaults, chart presets and output formats
- [Color patches](https://github.com/Photivra/engine/blob/main/docs/COLOR_PATCHES.md): the built-in color chart patches (`color-patches` preset, `{ kind: "color-patch", patchId }`), their spectra and CIELAB
- [Image-plane scene](https://github.com/Photivra/engine/blob/main/docs/IMAGE_PLANE.md): a photo as a flat print in front of the camera (`{ kind: "image-plane" }`), its input, placement, print reflectance lattice and accuracy
- [Layered chart scenes](https://github.com/Photivra/engine/blob/main/docs/LAYERED_SCENES.md): (2.27.0) opaque cards at several distances in front of a back plane with point lights (`{ kind: "layered-chart" }`), each blurred by its own depth and cut by nearer cards; call `prepareLayeredChartScenes()` first; `resolveLayeredChartPreset` (staircase presets) and `calculateLayeredChartDepths` (per-surface blur and depth of field)
- [Mixed lighting and flash](https://github.com/Photivra/engine/blob/main/docs/MIXED_ILLUMINATION.md): `illumination` for `simulateCapture`: sources blended across the chart, point sources with inverse-square falloff, and (2.26.0) `illumination.flash`, an impulse light set by guide number (`{ guideNumberM }`, distance × f-number at ISO 100) or energy (`candelaSeconds`), mixed with ambient light (slow sync) and metered by the automatic modes
- [Light sources](https://github.com/Photivra/engine/blob/main/docs/LIGHT_SOURCES.md): representative fluorescent and LED spectra designed by Photivra (`createRepresentativeLightSourceIlluminant`), their CCT and color rendering
- [Content Credentials](https://github.com/Photivra/engine/blob/main/docs/CONTENT_CREDENTIALS.md): embed a caller-built C2PA manifest store in a JPEG, PNG or DNG export (`bindC2paManifestStore`), hash the bound bytes (`calculateC2paDataHash`), write the signed store at the same length (`setC2paManifestStore`) and find an existing store (`parseC2paManifestStore`); no keys, signature checks or network
- [Usage guide](https://github.com/Photivra/engine/blob/main/docs/USAGE.md): worked examples for every public area
- [API reference](https://github.com/Photivra/engine/blob/main/docs/API_REFERENCE.md): every root export, with a task-to-function index

## One call: a full simulated photo

- [simulateCapture()](https://github.com/Photivra/engine/blob/main/docs/api/facade-simulate-capture.md#simulatecapture): async; camera tier, lens, exposure and chart scene in, developed image plus `assumptions` and `provenance` out
- [simulateFalseColor()](https://github.com/Photivra/engine/blob/main/docs/api/facade-false-color-entry.md#simulatefalsecolor): async (2.28); the false color a demosaic produces for a capture request, per pixel in CIELAB a*b* against a full-color sensor reading, noise-free

## Single calculations by task

- [calculateExposureValue100()](https://github.com/Photivra/engine/blob/main/docs/api/exposure-exposure.md#calculateexposurevalue100): EV at ISO 100 from f-number and shutter seconds
- [calculateEquivalentIso()](https://github.com/Photivra/engine/blob/main/docs/api/exposure-exposure.md#calculateequivalentiso): ISO that keeps the same brightness after an aperture or shutter change
- [calculateDepthOfField()](https://github.com/Photivra/engine/blob/main/docs/api/optics-depth-of-field.md#calculatedepthoffield): near and far limits and hyperfocal distance (thin lens)
- [calculateDefocusCircle()](https://github.com/Photivra/engine/blob/main/docs/api/optics-depth-of-field.md#calculatedefocuscircle): blur-circle size for an out-of-focus subject
- [calculateDefocusDiscKernelRadius()](https://github.com/Photivra/engine/blob/main/docs/api/optics-defocus-disc-kernel.md#calculatedefocusdisckernelradius): whether `lens.defocus` can render a blur before you render it (the 64-site limit)
- [resolveGenericLens()](https://github.com/Photivra/engine/blob/main/docs/api/equipment-generic-lens-catalogue.md#resolvegenericlens): one of the 30 generic catalogue lenses ("PV 50 1.2 Pro") on a sensor, with its approximated optical character; `simulateCapture` renders it with `lens.catalogue`
- [calculateFieldOfView()](https://github.com/Photivra/engine/blob/main/docs/api/camera-field-of-view.md#calculatefieldofview): angle of view from focal length and sensor size
- [calculateEquivalentFocalLength35Mm()](https://github.com/Photivra/engine/blob/main/docs/api/camera-equivalent-focal-length.md#calculateequivalentfocallength35mm): crop factor and 35 mm-equivalent focal length
- [calculateSensorEquivalence()](https://github.com/Photivra/engine/blob/main/docs/api/camera-sensor-equivalence.md#calculatesensorequivalence): equivalent focal length and f-number, sensor area ratio and angles of view of a lens on one sensor, each marked exact or approximated
- [calculateBlurShareOfFrame()](https://github.com/Photivra/engine/blob/main/docs/api/camera-sensor-equivalence.md#calculateblurshareofframe): a blur circle as a share of the frame diagonal, or its size on a print
- [calculateFormatEquivalentIso()](https://github.com/Photivra/engine/blob/main/docs/api/camera-sensor-equivalence.md#calculateformatequivalentiso): the equivalent ISO on another sensor format (k² × ISO), the ISO counterpart of the equivalent focal length and f-number
- [calculatePrintSizeLimitWithBlurAndNoise()](https://github.com/Photivra/engine/blob/main/docs/api/output-print-size-blur-noise.md#calculateprintsizelimitwithblurandnoise): the largest print at a viewing distance that still looks sharp and clean, counting blur and noise as well as pixels (an approximation)
- [calculateCenteredCrop()](https://github.com/Photivra/engine/blob/main/docs/api/output-crop.md#calculatecenteredcrop): pixels left after a centred crop
- [calculateCropToMatchFocalLength()](https://github.com/Photivra/engine/blob/main/docs/api/output-crop-to-match-focal-length.md#calculatecroptomatchfocallength): crop factor and pixels left when cropping a shorter lens's image to match a longer focal length
- [calculateApertureDiameter()](https://github.com/Photivra/engine/blob/main/docs/api/optics-aperture-diameter.md#calculateaperturediameter): entrance-pupil (aperture) diameter in mm, focal length ÷ f-number
- [calculateProjectedMotionBlur()](https://github.com/Photivra/engine/blob/main/docs/api/motion-projected-motion.md#calculateprojectedmotionblur): how far a moving subject smears on the sensor during the shutter time
- [createHandShakeTrajectory()](https://github.com/Photivra/engine/blob/main/docs/api/motion-hand-shake.md#createhandshaketrajectory): a bounded, seeded hand-shake rotation (sway and 8–12 Hz tremor, 4.39 °/s RMS, levelling off near 1°), scaled by 2^−stabilizationStops; `simulateCapture`'s `motion.handheld: { seed, stabilizationStops }` renders it on every path
- [calculateFilteredExposureTime()](https://github.com/Photivra/engine/blob/main/docs/api/exposure-filtered-exposure-time.md#calculatefilteredexposuretime): shutter time that keeps the same exposure with an ND (or any front-of-lens) filter, and the nearest shutter-dial value; `GENERIC_ND_FILTER_PROFILES` gives idealized 3-, 6- and 10-stop filters (exactly 2^-N)
- [calculateSunnySixteenExposure()](https://github.com/Photivra/engine/blob/main/docs/api/exposure-exposure-helpers.md#calculatesunnysixteenexposure): the sunny-16 base exposure for a daylight condition at an ISO
- [calculateStandardExposure()](https://github.com/Photivra/engine/blob/main/docs/api/exposure-exposure-helpers.md#calculatestandardexposure): metered EV and a settings pair for a named light level (`NAMED_LIGHT_LEVELS`), an illuminance or a luminance
- [calculateFreezeShutterSpeed()](https://github.com/Photivra/engine/blob/main/docs/api/exposure-exposure-helpers.md#calculatefreezeshutterspeed): the slowest shutter that keeps a moving subject's blur under a limit
- [calculateProgramLine()](https://github.com/Photivra/engine/blob/main/docs/api/facade-program-line-for-lens.md#calculateprogramline): the capture's program line for a lens's f-number range, and the pair it chooses for a scene EV
- [calculateDetailLimit()](https://github.com/Photivra/engine/blob/main/docs/api/optics-detail-limit.md#calculatedetaillimit): which limits detail for given settings, the lens (diffraction, aberrations, defocus) or the sensor's pixel pitch, with the optics MTF50, the Nyquist frequency and the system MTF50
- [calculateAiryDisk()](https://github.com/Photivra/engine/blob/main/docs/api/optics-diffraction.md#calculateairydisk): diffraction spot size from f-number and wavelength
- [calculateSignalToNoise()](https://github.com/Photivra/engine/blob/main/docs/api/sensor-signal-noise.md#calculatesignaltonoise): expected SNR from signal and read noise in electrons
- [calculateSensorFigures()](https://github.com/Photivra/engine/blob/main/docs/api/facade-sensor-figures.md#calculatesensorfigures): dynamic range, read noise and mid-grey SNR of a sensor profile or tier at an ISO, as a capture reports them (async)
- [calculateChromaticityFromCorrelatedColorTemperature()](https://github.com/Photivra/engine/blob/main/docs/api/color-illuminants.md#calculatechromaticityfromcorrelatedcolortemperature): white point for a colour temperature in kelvin
- [resolveColorTemperatureWhiteBalance()](https://github.com/Photivra/engine/blob/main/docs/api/color-white-balance.md#resolvecolortemperaturewhitebalance): Kelvin + tint white balance to camera channel gains

## Reference

- [Per-module API pages](https://github.com/Photivra/engine/tree/main/docs/api): generated signatures and doc comments for each source module
- [Error types](https://github.com/Photivra/engine/blob/main/docs/api/core-validation.md#invalidscientificinputerror): `InvalidScientificInputError` (RangeError) and `InvalidConfigurationError` (TypeError)
- [README](https://github.com/Photivra/engine/blob/main/README.md): overview and "Important scientific limits"
